reviews.reviewText: Paper divided into three parts. MS Word (approx 20 MCQs), Excel, PowerPoint. Coding concepts (ICS level). Remaining questions from coding and other concepts.

Mostly quizzes from handouts. 90% Handouts, 10% Files.
Questions Covered:
- Stack operations (Push, Delete, Insert, Drop).
- Tree definitions (Longest path, Parent-Children relationship).
- MS Word (Symbols, Style group, Text box, Line spacing, Highlight text, Format painter, Drop cap).
- C++ Operators (%=).
- XML attributes.
- Shortcuts (Ctrl+V).
- Pseudocodes & Algorithms.
- Waterfall model.
- Database purpose.
- Turing test date.
- Functional paradigm language (Python).
- AI & Email.
- History (FORTRAN, COBOL).
- OOP Languages.
- HTML extension.
- Dreamweaver.
- Computer Fraud and Abuse Act 1984.
- Encryption (Public Key).
- HTTPS Protocol.

Zyada MCQs MS Word ke baare main thay (Tabs, Tools). MS Excel ke 4-5 MCQs thay. MS Access bhi tha.
Specific Questions:
- Condition output finding.
- Hash function.
- C++ Modulus (7%3 result).
- MS Word main image kahan se add karte hain.
- Illustration group main kya hota hai.
- Home page par konsi cheezain hoti hain.
- Zyada paper last walay topics mein se aya tha.

Most questions were from MS Word and Excel. 4-5 questions required to find code outputs. There were also questions about Networking and Security. The paper was conceptual and mostly from handouts. Concepts need to be clear.

Overall paper bohat conceptual tha aur mostly MCQs depth mein se thay. MS Word mein se zyada MCQs thay (Home ribbon ke baray mein). XML abbreviation thi. Overall abbreviations bohat kam thin. COBOL ka 1 MCQ tha. C language mein '11 % 3' ka output poocha tha. Sirf highlighted points ya files karne se paper acha nahi hoga, handouts ko achy se prepare karain.
Paper easy tha. Majority handouts mein se aya hua tha, aur MS Office mein se ziada portion tha. Minority mein conceptual questions bhi thay but overall paper easy tha.

Paper was mostly from Handouts.
MCQs Topics:
- MS Word (Tabs, Tools, Shortcuts, Inserting Images, Illustration group) - 13-14 MCQs.
- MS Excel (Countif, Formulas) - 4-5 MCQs.
- MS Access - 6 MCQs.
- MS PowerPoint - 2 MCQs.
- Abbreviations (NLP, CSS).
- Coding: Condition finding, C++ Math (7/5, 10%4), While loop.
- Hash function, HTML attributes role.
- Semantic meaning in programming.
- Malware definition.
- Formal definition of algorithm.
Paper zyada tar handouts se tha. Abbreviations, binary system aur basic networking se conceptual questions aaye. Overall paper easy tha aur handouts parhne walon ke liye simple tha.
Final term paper mostly handouts se aaya. Bits and bytes, OSI model aur GUI se short conceptual questions thay. Definitions aur basics strong hon to paper easy lagta hai.
